title: Devices
hint: Your devices sync directly with each other on your local network — never through a server. Changes made on one device reach the others the next time they are on the same network.
pending_one: {count} change from here not on it yet
pending_other: {count} changes from here not on it yet
removeWarning: {name} stops syncing with all your devices. It keeps the copy it already has, protected by your master password: if it was lost or stolen, change the passwords of your important logins.
conflicts_one: {count} item had two different passwords: the newest is kept, the other is in the password history.
conflicts_other: {count} items had two different passwords: the newest is kept, the other is in the password history.
fileSaved_one: Saved {count} change for {name}. Move the file to it (USB stick, nearby sharing…) and import it there. Only {name} can open it.
fileSaved_other: Saved {count} changes for {name}. Move the file to it (USB stick, nearby sharing…) and import it there. Only {name} can open it.
noNetwork: No shared network? Use {syncFile} to carry changes on a USB stick, then {importLink} on the other device.
added: {name} was added. It syncs whenever both devices are on the same network.
